You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Delek US Holdings, Inc. (pre-combination entity), realized record ~3-5 years after closing

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because this registrant terminated its own SEC
> reporting duty at closing, there is no subsequent 10-K filed under its own CIK; the
> realized-record facts below are traced through EDGAR filing status and a successor
> registrant's own disclosures. This sub-dossier contains no information about how the
> transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On July 3, 2017, the registrant (CIK 0001351541) filed a Form 15 certifying
  termination/suspension of its duty to file reports under the Exchange Act, and
  reported approximately one holder of record for its common stock as of the
  certification date. [SRC: SEC accession 0001351541-17-000248, Form 15-12B]
- No annual report (Form 10-K) or other periodic report has been filed under this
  registrant's own CIK since that July 2017 deregistration filing; EDGAR's current
  submissions record for this CIK shows its name changed from "Delek US Holdings,
  Inc." to "Delek US Energy, Inc." effective the same period. [SRC: SEC EDGAR submissions history, CIK 0001351541, https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001351541.json]

## Successor reporting entity and separability of the business's record
- A separate registrant (CIK 0001694426), formerly named "Delek Holdco, Inc." and
  renamed "Delek US Holdings, Inc." effective July 10, 2017, is the entity that has
  continued to file periodic reports and trade on the NYSE under the ticker "DK"
  since the transaction closed. [SRC: SEC EDGAR submissions history, CIK 0001694426, https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001694426.json]
- This successor registrant's Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2020 (roughly
  3.5 years after closing) describes itself as having "acquired the outstanding
  common stock of Alon USA Energy, Inc." effective July 1, 2017, "resulting in a new
  post-combination consolidated registrant renamed as Delek US Holdings, Inc.," and
  reports its operating results in three reportable segments defined by function
  (Refining, Logistics, Retail) plus a "Corporate, Other and Eliminations" category. [SRC: SEC accession 0001694426-21-000034, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2020]
- None of the successor's reportable segments is organized by pre-combination
  corporate origin: the only segment-note reference to the pre-combination Alon
  business found in that Form 10-K (its acquired asphalt-terminal operations) appears
  folded into the "Corporate, Other and Eliminations" category rather than presented
  as a stand-alone line, and no comparable stand-alone disclosure isolates the
  pre-combination Delek business either. [SRC: SEC accession 0001694426-21-000034, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2020]

## Assessment
- Because the registrant named in this record (CIK 0001351541) terminated its own SEC
  reporting obligations at closing, and its operating business has since been
  reported only as part of a single consolidated successor registrant's results
  (which also fully incorporate the formerly separate Alon business, without a
  disclosed segment-level split by pre-combination origin), no public 3-5-year
  financial or operating record isolates this entity's own business apart from the
  business it combined with. [SRC: SEC accession 0001351541-17-000248, Form 15-12B] [SRC: SEC accession 0001694426-21-000034, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2020]
- The post-closing realized trajectory of this entity's business, considered apart
  from the business it combined with, is UNVERIFIED / not separately observable in
  the public record reviewed. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- No separate, entity-specific 3-5-year outcome record is publicly observable for
  this registrant: it deregistered at closing (Form 15, July 2017) and its operating
  business has since been reported only within a single successor registrant's fully
  consolidated results alongside another combined business, with no disclosed
  segment-level split that would isolate this entity's own trajectory; the outcome is
  therefore coded uncertain rather than inferred from the successor's consolidated
  figures. [SRC: SEC accession 0001351541-17-000248, Form 15-12B] [SRC: SEC accession 0001694426-21-000034, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2020]

[SLICE END]
